metricDefinitions.name: constraint-evaluations
metricDefinitions.description: Number of constraint measurements, including the repeated measurements of candidate checks that repair candidates; they do not use the evaluation budget.

metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.real
metricDefinitions.description: Number of evaluations of the real optimisation function.

metricDefinitions.name: evaluations.surrogate
metricDefinitions.description: Number of predictions of a surrogate model.

propertyDefinitions.name: violation-1
propertyDefinitions.description: Degree of violation of the constraint 1 of the group 'budget': data 'x:0' + data 'x:1' >= 1.0 (0 if satisfied).

propertyDefinitions.name: violation-2
propertyDefinitions.description: Degree of violation of the constraint 2 of the group 'box': data 'k:0' > 2 (0 if satisfied).

propertyDefinitions.name: attempts
propertyDefinitions.description: The number of variations of a candidate that a candidate check resampled, or the number of attempts of the repair of a repaired candidate.

propertyDefinitions.name: attempts
propertyDefinitions.description: Like the property of the relationship, for a candidate without predecessor.

propertyDefinitions.name: repair
propertyDefinitions.description: The repair strategy that repaired the candidate after a failed candidate check.

propertyDefinitions.name: repair
propertyDefinitions.description: Like the property of the relationship, for a candidate without predecessor.

propertyDefinitions.name: operators
propertyDefinitions.description: The recombinations and mutations that changed the child, in their order.

propertyDefinitions.name: changed-features
propertyDefinitions.description: The features whose genes differ from the parent whose place the child takes.
